boundary: The independently running signer and verifier use ephemeral pre-enrolled synthetic Ed25519 keys. This does not establish a real external owner's identity, key custody or trust enrollment. Full owner runtime remains in a separate ZIP.
next: Test independently governed trust-anchor enrollment, key rotation and challenge-use accounting across processes; withhold proof where a signer authority cannot be established.
observation: A distinct verifier process validated three signed, challenge-bound source scopes against separately pinned keys before a fresh two-pass owner-backed receipt audit. Independent tasks stayed separate; substituted keys and stale sources failed closed.
preserved: Previous 273 archive entries unchanged; each task keeps its own route obligations, prior receipts are historical only, missing edges remain unproved, and no new source observations were created.
summary: Challenge-bound Ed25519 source attestations can be checked in a separate process, followed by mandatory fresh owner-backed route proof for independently declared tasks.
title: Independent-process source attestations
